```{r}
install.packages(c("tidyverse", "lubridate"))

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

```


```{r}
load("datasets/malaria_2016.RData")
malaria_2016 <- data

load("datasets/malaria_2017.RData")
malaria_2017 <- data

load("datasets/malaria_2018.RData")
malaria_2018 <- data

load("datasets/malaria_2019.RData")
malaria_2019 <- data

ls()

```
```{r}
#junção de dts
malaria <- bind_rows(
  malaria_2016,
  malaria_2017,
  malaria_2018,
  malaria_2019
)
```
```{r}
glimpse(malaria)
```

```{r}
#filtragem cols usadas
malaria <- malaria %>%
  select(
    exam.interval,
    treatment.interval,
    notification.interval,
    notification.month,
    notification.year,
    migration,
    autochthonous.case,
    exam.result,
    detection.type,
    exam.type,
    symptom,
    hemiparasite,
    previous.treatment,
    occupation,
    education.level,
    age,
    race,
    gender
  )
```

```{r}
#tipagem
malaria <- malaria %>%
  mutate(
    notification.month = as.numeric(as.character(notification.month)),
    notification.year = as.numeric(as.character(notification.year)),
  )

glimpse(malaria)
```
